text:
marie (pm): OK team — we need to lock the enterprise retention scope for Q3. Customer asks + SOC2 mapping + BYOK handoff. Quick sync?

aj (eng): can we split into 3 tickets: audit export, retention TTLs, KMS handshake? keeps scope manageable.

samir (sec): SOC2 notes: 90/180/365 buckets minimum, encryption at rest, key rotation proof. BYOK has legal/escrow implications.

tasha (legal): for BYOK we need contract language about key escrow exceptions, termination key handling, and legal-hold carveouts. I can draft baseline text.

derek (cs): FYI customer-ACME pushed for 7-year audit retention for specific logs. calling out cost + SLA expectations.

aj (eng): rough back-of-envelope: 7-year cold archive ~ +$0.04/GB/month (storage only). indexing for search adds more. Need to decide cold vs searchable.

marie (pm): draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
- configurable retention per tenant (days/buckets)
- exportable audit evidence in ndjson + manifest, signed for chain-of-custody
- BYOK handshake flow with rotation proof and optional escrow flag
- SOC2 evidence mapping doc (control IDs -> artifact list)

samir (sec): add: rotation proof must include HSM-signed rotation events in the audit stream and verifiable timestamps.

derek (cs): customer asks: temporary legal-hold toggle to prevent deletions during investigations — high priority for enterprise.

aj (eng): prototype retention config YAML (rough):
```
retention:
  default_days: 365
  tenant_overrides:
    - tenant_id: T-123
      days: 2555 # 7 years
  legal_hold_enabled: false
  tenant_region_policy: eu-west
```

marie (pm): good. Next steps:
- aj: infra spike for export API + manifest signing by EOW
- tasha: BYOK contract baseline draft by Wed
- samir: SOC2 mapping doc (control -> evidence) by Thu
- derek: collect top-3 customer retention asks and examples by Tue

derek (cs): will do. question: do customers want cold-tier search or just raw export for >1y? most asked for search within 30 days only.

aj (eng): proposal: 90 days hot (fast search), 1 year warm (searchable but degraded perf), rest cold as raw blobs with manifest and optional rehydrate.

samir (sec): SLOs to consider: hot search < 2s, warm search 48-72h, export delivery SLA 24h for small sets, 7 days for bulk archival requests.

marie (pm): I'll open an RFC and link it here: https://docs.redwood.ai/product/retention-rfc (placeholder)

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for branch retention-prototype -> staging at 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC :rocket:

marie (pm): pairing session for acceptance tests: aj + samir Monday 10:00am PT.

tasha (legal): question — jurisdiction based retention rules? e.g., some EU customers require min retention, some industries require immediate deletion on contract end. we need tenant_region_policy details.

marie (pm): agreed — add tenant_region_policy and contract-event triggers to RFC.

aj (eng): I'll include a small sample of export manifest format in the spike:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "T-123",
  "range": {"from": "2020-01-01", "to": "2027-01-01"},
  "files": ["audit-2020.ndjson.gz", "audit-2021.ndjson.gz"],
  "signature": "base64sig"
}
```

marie (pm): summary / actions (TL;DR):
- scope: per-tenant retention + legal-hold + export format + BYOK handshake + SOC2 mapping
- owners: aj (engineer spike + export), samir (security mapping + rotation proof), tasha (legal BYOK language), derek (customer asks)
- deadlines: spike/EOW, drafts mid-week, RFC link updated by Fri

marie (pm): tagging for visibility: @here please add any other blockers.

aj (eng): no blockers from infra team yet. I'll post a short design doc Monday.

samir (sec): I'll also note compliance checklist items for ISO in the RFC.

marie (pm): thanks everyone — I'll convert this to an RFC and create the three tickets.
